test_purpose: Grant maximum: requests $12,500 (max $10,000). Only R12 should fail. All organisations, people and ABNs are fictional.

project.title: Festival of Nations Student Stage
project.description: A student stage at a community festival where international student groups perform music and dance from their home countries for the Darwin public.
project.who_can_attend: Open to all international students studying in the Northern Territory. Entry is free.
project.wellbeing_benefit: Students share their culture and the community learns about the value international students bring to the NT.
